changes: Add a Project-owned conformance-assessment registry bound to the exact adopted parent-contract record, adoption decision, inherited contract, parent version, and instance profile state.
Evaluate every mandatory inherited-contract term separately and preserve its exact source evidence without rewriting the adopted contract or candidate envelope.
Record the live system-ontology validation BLOCK, DomainSpec source-currentness failures, receipt-currency failure, and stale cross-package residue as evidence-currency blockers.
Require the aggregate result to remain indeterminate, conformance not proven, and binding eligibility denied while any evidence-currency or bridge-drift blocker remains.
Keep the concrete RecursiveInstanceBinding registry empty.
migration: The Goals package profile moves from v7 to v8 and adds the conformance-assessment registry plus this amendment. All v7 candidate, decision, admission, adoption, Project, Goal, authority-claim, inherited-contract, and empty concrete binding records retain their identities and bytes.
rollback: Remove the conformance-assessment registry and this amendment and restore the v7 profile/schema/validator/view/residue/README only before later evidence references the assessment ID. Never rewrite the immutable adoption decision or adopted-parent-contract record.
claim_ceiling: Review-only structural conformance evidence with an indeterminate aggregate result; no conformance proof, D64 satisfaction, authority activation, binding registration, runtime acceptance, implementation, publication, deployment, or external effect.
